A [[Gender/Legends|female]] named '''Alyssa''' operated as a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] under the alias '''alyssaroxu''' during the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The inept fellow slicer [[wampa1]] misidentified alyssaroxu as one [[Alysssa Maggrit]] in a failed attempt to publicly reveal her true name on the HoloNet.
